sentences.en: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
sentences.zh: 你想要知道如何防止起皱纹吗？

sentences.en: This skin care product claims that it can remove wrinkles.
sentences.zh: 这款护肤产品声称可以去除皱纹。

sentences.en: At what age do most people start to develop wrinkles?
sentences.zh: 大多数人从什么年龄开始出现皱纹？

mnemonic: 联想记忆：眨眼（twinkle）容易起皱纹（wrinkle）
